title: PLAN Product Repository Repair Boundary Checklist

items.label: Capture the PLAN product-repository repair boundary context.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, Evidence target, risks, and unknowns are identified before editing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > agent-and-skill-design, owner repo-project-control, active role project-control-steward with documentation-authority-steward responsibility, phase target phase-agent-and-skill-design-plan-product-repair-boundary, checklist target checklist-agent-and-skill-design-plan-product-repair-boundary, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-plan-product-repair-boundary-2026-09-03.

items.label: Write a failing guard for the PLAN product-repository repair boundary.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Project Control test fails before the phase, evidence, entrypoint wording, and first-delivery boundary-risk wording exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-plan-product-repair-boundary.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because agent-and-skill-design did not yet include phase-agent-and-skill-design-plan-product-repair-boundary or evidence-flowdoc-plan-product-repair-boundary-2026-09-03.

items.label: Define the PLAN product-repository repair boundary.
items.evidenceTarget: Delivery and orchestration documents state that PLAN must not patch product repositories after dispatch and must send product-repository repair back to the same WORK room when possible.
items.verificationNote: AGENTS.md, docs/domains/flowdoc-global-codex-guidance.md, docs/domains/agent-and-skill-operating-model.md, docs/domains/flowdoc-delivery-operating-model.md, and docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md state that PLAN may diagnose and attach failure evidence but product-repository repair goes back to the same WORK room as a Revision Packet.

items.label: Route the repair boundary through agent entrypoints.
items.evidenceTarget: Future PLAN rooms reading Project Control AGENTS.md, global guidance, delivery, orchestration, and agent operating model see the same boundary.
items.verificationNote: The entrypoints distinguish forbidden product-repository repair from PLAN-owned merge, verification, Project Control records, and cleanup that do not change product repository files or product behavior.

items.label: Record the first-delivery boundary breach risk.
items.evidenceTarget: The first-delivery owner-lane acceptance record preserves that PLAN-side Backend verification repair was a boundary breach risk rather than the future model.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-first-delivery-owner-lanes-acceptance-2026-09-03.md records the Backend PLAN-side repair as a boundary breach risk and points future PLAN rooms to the same-room WORK Revision Packet path.

items.label: Verify the focused guard and Project Control gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Project Control guard, generation, data validation, and full Project Control gate pass after the boundary is registered.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: tests/flowdoc-plan-product-repair-boundary.test.ts, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
